feature: Graph Database Integration with Graphiti-Core for Context Management
workflow_rationale: This is a new feature adding graph database capabilities (Neo4j + graphiti-core) to the existing system. It involves infrastructure changes (Docker), new dependencies, and service creation following the established singleton service pattern.

phases.name: Infrastructure Setup
phases.description: Set up Neo4j Docker container and add graphiti-core dependency

subtasks.notes: Added Neo4j 5.26 service to docker-compose.yml with HTTP (7474) and Bolt (7687) ports, environment variables, volumes, resource limits, healthcheck, and dependencies in backend and celery_worker services
Added 'graphiti-core>=0.7.8' to requirements.txt in ML/NLP Libraries section

subtasks.description: Add Neo4j environment variables to config.py
subtasks.notes: Added neo4j_uri (bolt://localhost:7687), neo4j_user (neo4j), neo4j_password (password), and graphiti_telemetry_enabled (bool, default False) fields to Settings class following existing patterns

phases.name: Graphiti Service Module
phases.description: Create the GraphitiService wrapper following singleton service pattern

verification.command: python -c "from backend.services.graphiti_service import GraphitiService, get_graphiti_service; print('OK')"

subtasks.notes: Created GraphitiService class with: __init__(uri, user, password), async initialize() (builds indices/constraints), async add_episode(), async search(), async health_check(), async close(). Added global _graphiti_service instance, get_graphiti_service() accessor, and set_graphiti_service() for testing. Proper error handling with ImportError for missing graphiti-core package.

Successfully initialized GraphitiService in main.py lifespan. Added import of get_graphiti_service, added initialization in startup with graceful error handling (logs warning but doesn't crash if Graphiti fails to initialize), and added cleanup in shutdown with error handling.

phases.name: Context API Endpoints
phases.description: Create API endpoints for graph-based context operations

subtasks.description: Create context.py API module with endpoints
subtasks.notes: Created backend/api/context.py with APIRouter and 3 endpoints: POST /episodes (add episode with EpisodeRequest model), GET /search (semantic search with query/limit params), GET /health (health check returning healthy/initialized/neo4j_connected/episode_count). Includes Pydantic models (EpisodeRequest, EpisodeResponse, SearchResult, SearchResponse, HealthResponse), proper async error handling (503 for service unavailable, 422 for validation, 500 for errors), and follows existing API patterns from resumes.py and analysis.py.
Added context to import list and registered router: app.include_router(context.router, prefix='/api/v1/context', tags=['Context'])

phases.name: Integration and Verification
phases.description: Verify end-to-end functionality of graphiti integration

subtasks.description: Verify Neo4j container starts and is accessible

verification.command: docker-compose ps neo4j && curl -s http://localhost:7474 | grep -i neo4j
verification.expected: Neo4j container healthy and UI accessible

subtasks.notes: Added Neo4j environment variables to .env.example and .env. Neo4j configuration in docker-compose.yml is correct (verified). Created verify_neo4j.sh script for full verification. Actual container start/verification requires main project Docker environment which is not accessible in worktree. To verify: cd /Users/fraud/Projects/agenthr && docker-compose up -d neo4j

Implementation verified: context.py has health endpoint, main.py registers router and initializes GraphitiService in lifespan. Created verify_graphiti_init.sh script and verification-summary-subtask-4-2.md. Runtime verification pending merge to main project (changes in auto-claude/110-graphiti worktree branch).

subtasks.description: Verify episode ingestion and search flow

steps: POST episode to /api/context/episodes with test data
Verify response contains episode_id and status: created
GET /api/context/search with query matching episode content
Verify search returns the episode in results

subtasks.notes: Created verify_episode_flow.sh shell script for manual E2E verification and backend/tests/integration/test_context_e2e.py with comprehensive test coverage. Test classes: TestHealthEndpoint (health check validation), TestEpisodeIngestion (episode creation), TestSemanticSearch (search functionality), TestEndToEndWorkflows (complete workflow scenarios), TestErrorHandling (error cases). Shell script tests: POST /api/v1/context/episodes → verify episode_id/status: created → GET /api/v1/context/search → verify results. Runtime verification pending merge to main project.

subtasks.description: Verify graph data in Neo4j browser

verification.instructions: Open Neo4j Browser at http://localhost:7474, login with neo4j/password, run query: MATCH (n) RETURN count(n) to verify nodes exist after episode ingestion

subtasks.notes: Manual verification of graph data in Neo4j browser UI

acceptance_criteria: Neo4j container starts successfully in Docker
graphiti-core package is installed and importable
GraphitiService follows singleton pattern with get_graphiti_service() accessor
Service initializes on app startup with build_indices_and_constraints()
Can add episodes via POST endpoint
Can search for context via GET endpoint
Health check returns Neo4j connectivity status
No console errors on startup or endpoint usage
Neo4j browser UI shows graph data after ingestion
verification_strategy.reasoning: High risk change involving new database technology (Neo4j) and new dependency (graphiti-core). Requires comprehensive testing including unit tests for the service, integration tests for Neo4j connectivity, E2E tests for episode ingestion/search, security scanning for credentials handling, and staging deployment to verify Docker stack compatibility.
